The screen is complete. Summary of what was built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- A beneficiaries list using Strata's `DataTable`, with columns for name (with avatar), bank (with an icon tile), masked account number (last 4 digits), and date added — mock data defined in the file.
- Sorting enabled on the Name and Added columns via `sortDescriptor`/`useSortedRows`.
- Icon-only Edit (pencil) and Remove (trash) buttons per row, each with an accessible `aria-label`. Edit opens a dialog with a small form (name, bank select, account digits) that updates the row; Remove opens a confirmation `AlertDialog`.
- Row selection (checkboxes) that reveals a "N selected" bar with "Clear" and "Remove selected" actions when any rows are selected; bulk removal also goes through a confirmation dialog.
- An empty state for when all beneficiaries have been removed, and locale-aware date formatting so it works correctly under the `en-IN`/`ar-AE` locales and RTL.
